normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only exists to drive the value-forwarding call in sendValue.
Signature bytes are decoded and validated solely inside recover.
Amount parameter is consumed by the internal send path.
Node index is validated and indexed against the channel inside broadcast.
Verification vector is length-checked and hashed inside broadcast.
Secret number is only used to derive the ECDH key during response.
Boolean flag only influences how rotateNode records the leaving history.
Amount is stored and balance-checked inside the delegate flow.
Signature is recovered within linkNodeAddress to verify node ownership.
Space amount feeds the freeSpace subtraction in removeSpaceFromNode.
Public key is packed into NodeCreationParams for node creation.
Value is validated and added to the approved amount.
Deposit is compared with the computed schain price in addSchain.
Derived delta local feeds the price arithmetic on the critical path.
Load difference is a temporary computed only for the price formula.
Group length sizes the DKG boolean arrays and channel n.
Random seed local drives the pseudo-random node selection loop.
Blockhash-derived random value drives group member selection.
Signal array is produced and consumed by the slash processing entrypoint.
New node index is returned by _addNode as part of createNode.
Bounty local is the computed reward returned by getBounty.
Resolved controller instance is only used to process slashes inside the lock query.
